item.title: Memorial Coliseum Ticketing, Parking, and Accessibility Guidelines Updated
item.description:
Memorial Coliseum Ticketing, Parking, and Accessibility Guidelines Updated

The Memorial Coliseum has released a set of detailed guidelines covering show hours, ticket verification, parking rates, accessibility accommodations, photography rules, and child admission policies.

📅 Show Hours & Admission

  • Shows run from 10 AM to 4 PM.
  • Children 3 years and under are free for most events.
  • Children under 2 years are free unless a separate seat is requested.
  • Rules for children can vary by event; verify the individual event for specifics.

🎟️ Ticketing Details

  • Ticket office phone: (260) 483‑1111.
  • Doors open 2 hours prior to the event.
  • To pick up tickets, present one of the following:
    • Photo ID
    • Confirmation number
    • Credit card used for the purchase

🚗 Parking Rates

Parking Area Rate per Vehicle
Main Lot $8.00
Preferred Lot $12.00
Buses, RVs, Limos $16.00

♿ Accessibility

  • Accessible seating is available at all purchase points.
  • Seats are reserved for sight‑ or hearing‑impaired patrons.
  • Special amenities include hearing devices and sign‑language interpreters.
  • For assistance, contact the MidWest America Ticket Office at 260‑483‑1111.
  • TTY assistance is reachable at 260‑480‑2108.

📸 Camera & Recording Policy

  • Still‑photo cameras are permitted for certain events.
  • Video cameras and recording devices are prohibited for most events.
  • For event‑specific policies, visit www.memorialcoliseum.com.

📞 Contact Information

  • General ticketing inquiries: (260) 483‑1111.
  • Special‑amenities requests: (260) 483‑1111.
  • TTY machine: (260) 480‑2108.

All information reflects the latest guidelines as of October 10, 2026.

#Ticketing #Accessibility #VenuePolicies

Source: Tickets, Live at Allen County War Memorial Coliseum, Fort Wayne on Oct 11, 2026 | Consequence Live

item.title: How to Attend the 2026 World Cup Matches in Dallas
item.description:
How to Attend the 2026 World Cup Matches in Dallas

If you missed your chance to buy tickets for the World Cup’s Dallas matches, there are still a few ways to get in before the action kicks off at AT&T Stadium.

📅 Overview

  • The information reflects the situation as of Apr 20, 2026.
  • Event inquiries are handled Monday‑Friday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM.
  • Phone contact: (214) 741‑8328.

🎟️ Ticket & Reservation Details

  • Reservations must be confirmed at the time of purchase.
  • A valid photo ID is required for ticket pickup.
  • A call‑window will be located at the main entrance.
  • For groups of eight or more, a reservation is recommended.
  • Cancellations require a 24‑hour notice.

🚗 Parking & Transportation

  • Limited on‑site parking is available.
  • Street parking is offered on surrounding streets.
  • Nearby paid parking lots serve the downtown Dallas area.
  • Metered parking is within 1–2 blocks of the venue.
  • Public transportation or ride‑share services are recommended.

♿ Accessibility

  • ADA‑accessible seating is provided.
  • Wheelchair‑accessible restrooms are available.
  • Main‑floor accessibility and elevator access to upper levels (if applicable) are in place.
  • Contact the venue in advance for specific accessibility needs.

👥 Age, Dress & Policies

  • Age restriction: 21+ for some events; evening events and alcohol‑service areas also have age limits.
  • Dress code: Business casual is recommended.
  • No outside beverages are permitted.
  • Photography policy: Inquire with the venue.

👶 Family & Children

  • Children are permitted during daytime hours (before 5 PM).
  • Accompanied minors are welcome at family‑oriented events.
  • High chairs are available upon request.
  • Contact the venue for special children’s event arrangements.

📞 Contact & Additional Information

  • For event inquiries, call during business hours (Monday‑Friday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM).
  • Phone: (214) 741‑8328.
  • Verify reservation confirmation at purchase and bring a valid photo ID for pickup.
  • Ask about photography rules, dress expectations, and any specific accessibility or family needs ahead of time.

#WorldCup #Dallas #Ticketing #VenueInfo

Source: Guardin Tickets, Live at TX Tea Room, Dallas on Oct 09, 2026 | Consequence Live
